mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above the previous quarter's average, observed by the decision date, signals tighter monetary policy that raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS rises above its prior quarter's average.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 falls by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which depresses consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods when UNRATE exceeds 5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average, sustained for three consecutive months, indicates supply-side contraction that raises input costs and reduces output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of three consecutive months of INDPRO below its 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and a fall in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for two months signals a successful disinflationary tightening, which initially boosts risk assets due to declining inflation uncertainty, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases AND CPIAUCSL < 2% for 2 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls below 2% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated rise in both personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above their respective 12-month moving averages signals robust demand expansion, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed their 12-month moving averages simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals labor market strength, which supports consumer spending and corporate profitability, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp month-on-month decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 3% signals a sudden collapse in consumer demand, which rapidly reduces corporate revenue expectations and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS falls by more than 3% month-on-month.
